updates.after: # ZenTao Bug 7025 The home-page key-data navigation card title on zhi2-web-admin (Suzhou Housing G) wrapped and was obscured by its value when the left menu was expanded; hop2 on 2026-11-26 completed the fix, commit/push and ZenTao write-back, ending the chain on Section 4 clearance rather than a hop limit. ## Symptoms - ZenTao link http://zentao-biz.zhi.com/index.php?m=bug&f=view&bugID=7025; chain_id=bug7025-key-data-nav. - With the left menu expanded, the title "专业化物业管理住宅小区面积（万㎡）" wrapped and its last line "(万㎡)" was obscured by the value container; with the menu collapsed the title was single-line (expected). - Tester screenshot 1614×894 at 1614px viewport with menu expanded; local reproduction showed the card narrowing, label about 71px wide and wrapping to 4 lines. ## Root Cause - `KeyDataNav.vue:382-394` `.kd__label` lacked nowrap/ellipsis alongside `.kd__value`; parent `SectionCard.vue:126-128` overflow-y:hidden clipped/obscured the wrapped last line. - DOM geometry measured label bottom 345 and value top 347 with no literal overlap; visual recognition had misread it, so precise crop comparison was needed and the parent fixed height/overflow was authoritative. - Login reproduction: arithmetic CAPTCHA (9+4=13); the covered `data-testid="login-submit"` was bypassed with a direct JS click; menu toggling used `.hamburger-svg`. ## Fix and Commit - The fix changed only 3 CSS lines at `KeyDataNav.vue:382-389`; the commit staged only that file, leaving the 3 other dirty files untouched. - Verification gate was completed in hop1 and not rerun: eslint exit 0, baseline and post-change builds exit 0, agent-browser live screenshot placed in-session and user `verify_ok3` confirmation. - Submodule HEAD `5c5afbafe609d7ec7eabfeb62d0af1c1c8bf5a55` (short `5c5afbafe6`) and parent gitlink `d64cc6b4f4` were pushed with both ends' `git ls-remote` SHAs matching; post-commit build `version.json.gitHash=5c5afbafe` == HEAD (Sass deprecation warnings only). ## Write-back and Cleanup - In the new ZenTao DB, an idempotency check found no prior comment; a committed transaction set `zt_bug#7025` to resolved/fixed, resolvedBy=tiany, assigned back to openedBy=lichandan, with `zt_action#100555` comment containing `{24646.png}` and attachment fileID=24646 linked to the bug. - Deploy panel correction: the stale `frontend_url` 8101 was changed to local=8165 and test=8167, with other fields unchanged. - Cleanup, done only after the image was in-session and landed in ZenTao: browser sessions `b7025*` closed, `zentao-7025/` directory and all `bug7025-*.png` deleted. - Handoff: hop1 wrote a 9-section document `D:/plan/苏住房G/HANDOFF-CHAIN-bug7025-key-data-nav-hop1-20261126-1700.md` and scheduled `schedule-b4d95690...` at 17:01:43;
